fusions.name: Whaler's Harpoon
fusions.desc: Throws a harpoon into the first enemy it meets that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Mark
fusions.desc: A quick strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and has a 25% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: General Chase
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 30% for 10 seconds, with 8% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Chum in the Water
fusions.desc: Against a target carrying any condition, your damage rises by 10%.
